# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: what a shot and a death do to a player.
# map mp_carentan, gametype tdm, joined allies, weapon m1carbine_mp, role grenade-target, taken 227 traced snapshots over 200 s
# dedicated 1, sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults. Two probes on
# the server: a target that stands still and a shooter that walks up to it.
# The target kills itself with the `kill` client command 10 s in and every 45 s
# after, so the death, the corpse, the obituary and the respawn are captured
# whether or not the shooter ever finds a line of sight. It presses use 3 s
# after each death, and again once a second until the script takes one.
# Captured with tools/run_server.sh and --net-probe --probe-target / --save-hit.
# One !trace line per snapshot whose watched fields moved, plus one a second so
# a settled stretch still carries a timeline: a run is 20 snapshots a second
# for minutes and a standing player moves none of them. The shooter keeps every
# snapshot of its three firing phases whether or not anything moved.
# ms is since the role's script started; serverTime is the server's own clock.
# clip and ammo are the non-zero entries of the two arrays, as index:value.
[section target]
